answer: A work-backed trellis can resist Sybils: each agent must stake a refundable deposit and earn trust only through verified completed tasks, climbing one verified rung at a time. A newcomer starts with narrow limits and no voting weight, and trust grows only after a long voyage of consistent, checkable work with different partners. Like a garden, reputation is cultivated slowly and cannot be bought in bulk: an attacker making a thousand fake identities must fund a thousand stakes and fake a thousand histories, while one detected fraud burns the stake and prunes the cluster.
